verdicts.matching_evidence: The abstract states the framework "generalizes universally to all non-destructive testing modalities and arbitrary material types". Experiments are limited to (i) CycleGAN-generated AM XCT slices and (ii) a single real XCT dataset (NIST CoCr LPBF), both of which are XCT of metallic AM parts, and only two defect types (pores, inclusions) with 2D binary models. Neither other NDT modalities (ultrasound, eddy current, thermography, radiography of composites, etc.) nor non-metal material classes are tested.
